The NYT and LAT didn’t publish the story *anywhere* in their print editions. The Washington Post put it on page one (and LAT gave it prominent placement on its homepage for a bit Friday.)

Stunning that the NYT, which helped lead the way on #MeToo, is burying this.
#MeToo clearly hasn’t come to Indonesia. This is a horrifying story—and the sort of upside down, “1984”-style logic I fear is headed to the US under Trump.
